svg.title: ProofNova PactWeave — One Skill. Every Workflow. Verified.
svg.desc: Bounded plan → execute → review → repair. Local CLI: persistent storage and approved host adapters. Browser: deterministic tools and memory-only state.

g.text: Confirm the original request and refine the plan
Gather missing information only when needed
Orchestrate registered tools for the task
Trusted local commands require the CLI
Check facts, logic, edge cases and counterexamples
Assess whether the Task Contract is satisfied
Fix issues and retry within limits

svg.text: Only when needed · approved providers · disabled by
Retrieve only needed information from verifiable
Across sessions · separate from the LLM response cache
Local CLI: persistent storage and approved host adapters.
Browser: deterministic tools and memory-only state.
